positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
.Net Web Development - C#, ASP.NET, MVC, Entity Framework, SQL Server, WCF Web Services.

Implemented, Tested, and Deployed Web Application services and framework for integrating 3rd party enterprise software to Xerox Services Manager web-based management software.

Development lead responsible for design, development, automated unit testing, database design, and automated builds for ASP.NET MVC 4 Enterprise-level Content Management System.

Developed Web-based test harness for Xerox Services Connector, utilizing web services to integrate 3rd party help desk systems to Xerox Services Manager.

positions.title: Applications Developer
positions.description:
Applications and GUI developer for Xerox FreeFlow software. Create and maintain automated unit testing framework using open source tools.

Created web-based scheduler for automated testing of Xerox FreeFlow Suite of software applications. Developed SilkTest automated scripts. Created internal test team website.
